name: Island Events Scale With Population (like The Lost Children)
description: Island events' food and tech-point gains and losses grow with the village, as in The Lost Children: each amount is multiplied by 1 with up to 25 villagers, by 2 with 26 to 50 and by 3 with more than 50 (living villagers plus the babies being carried, as the game counts its population). The 14 amounts of 9 events are scaled: The Creeping Mold, The Mysterious Footprints (all four), The Arc of Brilliant Colors, The Calabash Instrument, The Climber, The Mosquito Larvae, Faces in the Night, The Sealed Box and The Aspiring Scientist. A loss still takes no more than there is, and Food Mastery still raises a food gain as the game does. A single-result event's popup shows the scaled amount (it prints the amount the game set); a two-choice event's result text is fixed (for example "Your tribe gains 5000 tech points."), so it still names the game's own amount while the scaled amount is what is given. Custom Island Events (Story / Cheat Upgrades) keep their own amounts. Nothing is saved, so the patch can be ticked or unticked at any time. **Needs no other patch.** **Cannot be ticked together with "Island Events Scale With Stored Food and Tech Points": the two scale the same amounts in different ways, so tick only one; with both ticked the patcher builds nothing.** Off by default; part of Classic VV Difficulty; Owner's Defaults ticks it. **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.** The companion is "VVFP Island Events Scale.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; if it cannot be loaded, the stock amounts are given.
behavior_changes: Each site below calls VVFP Island Events Scale.dll, which counts the population with the population routine 0x467610 on the villager manager (0x50E568, or where 256 Villagers moves it: the manager's static initialiser's own `mov ecx`, 0x488D70) and puts the stock amount x k in place of the stock amount, k = 3 above 50, 2 above 25, else 1 (The Lost Children's 0x41F720: cmp 0x32 / jle, cmp 0x19 / jle). A gain stays a gain and a loss a loss. A single-result loss (The Creeping Mold, The Mysterious Footprints' food and tech lost) is then clamped to what is stored by the companion, by the setter's own rule (stored below the amount: the amount is what is stored), because the setter itself tests the store against its stock amount (cmp eax, imm / jge); the setter's test then runs as in the stock game, and the {award} its popup shows is what is taken. The two-choice food and tech writers' floor at 0 runs after it, as in the stock game.
The Mysterious Footprints (tech gained): +2,000 tech points (0x414A00).
The Mysterious Footprints (tech lost): -2,000 tech points (0x414A50).
The Arc of Brilliant Colors, "Run to the right side" (rare mushrooms): +300 food (0x415201).
The Calabash Instrument, "Fill it up to the first notch": +3,000 tech points (0x41585A).
The Calabash Instrument, "Fill it to the top": -2,000 tech points (0x415867).
The Climber, "Start yelling for help": -500 tech points (0x415942).
The Mosquito Larvae, "Pour oil in the pond": +500 tech points (0x415A74).
Faces in the Night, "Inform the tribe": +1,000 tech points (0x415B39).
The Sealed Box, "Swim back with the box": +5,000 tech points (0x415D7F).
The Aspiring Scientist, "Try the salts": +2,000 tech points (0x416715).
The Aspiring Scientist, "Use algae": -1,000 tech points (0x416728).
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion writes each site at run time, only after verifying every site's stock bytes (all of them, or none).
The game's rolls, its food and tech writers (Food Mastery's raise included), the clamps, every other event, the popups' and buttons' texts, Custom Island Events and the save are unchanged.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; every site emulated on the stock executable with the shipped companion (k = 1, 2, 3 at 25, 26, 50 and 51 villagers, gains, losses and the loss clamp, the 256 Villagers manager) in tests/test_island_events_scale.py; runtime/player confirmation pending
